page: Google Cloud Platform n4a-highmem-1 is an arm64-based virtual machine instance belonging to the n4a server family. It features 1 dedicated virtual CPU and 8.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8 GB per core. The instance does not include local storage or bundled GPU hardware, and it is provisioned with zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

With its dedicated CPU allocation, the n4a-highmem-1 delivers predictable single-core processing capabilities without the performance variability associated with shared-core or burstable instances. The arm64 architecture provides a power-efficient hardware profile, offering a high memory density per vCPU. This configuration represents a cost-efficient option for workloads requiring more memory than compute power, avoiding the need to provision additional vCPUs simply to acquire sufficient RAM.

This server type is suited for lightweight memory-intensive applications, small-scale databases, caching layers, microservices, and arm64-native development or testing environments that require a dedicated CPU core but operate within a modest memory footprint.
